thread_text:
Nia Wallace: Recruiting ops flagged that new interviewers who completed calibration in the LMS aren't getting the `training_completed` bit on their ATS profile, so invites are being blocked by the gating rule. Affected panels: 11555, 11560. Anyone seen this?
Ravi Shah: Saw the webhook payloads from LMS; they POSTed completion events but our connector returned 202 with no ack. Example payload we received: {event: 'calibration_complete', user_id: 'u_1422', scorecard_link: 'https://lms.redwood/quiz/abc'}
Sam Gomez: The LMS team changed the event name to `calibration_complete_v2` during a deploy last night to include quiz_score. Our connector listens for `calibration_complete` only. That explains why the ATS flag never gets set.
Samir Khan: Quick mitigation: we can add dual-listening for both event names in the connector and set `training_completed=true` when either arrives. I'll prepare a small canary patch. Prefered timeline?
Nia Wallace: ASAP please — recruiting is blocking any panels created by new interviewers until we fix it. Can we also retroactively mark anyone who completed the v2 event in the last 72h?
Ravi Shah: We have an LMS audit log for the last 7 days. I can export events filtered by `calibration_complete_v2`. Export command: `./tools/lms-export --event calibration_complete_v2 --since 72h --format csv`
Sam Gomez: I'll wire the connector to accept both events and add an idempotent updater for the ATS profile: `POST /ats/profile/{user_id}/flags {training_completed:true, quiz_score:...}`. Canary ETA 25m.
RecruitBot: created ticket R-2026-1402: "LMS event name change -> missing training_completed flag blocking panels" assigned to Samir Khan and Sam Gomez due 2026-07-20
Samir Khan: Pushing canary now. After deploy Ravi, please paste the export CSV here and I'll run the backfill script: `./tools/ats-backfill-training --file lms_export.csv`. I'll post results.
Nia Wallace: Thanks. Also please add a one-line note in the interviewer onboarding doc explaining that training completion is gated and who to contact if invites are blocked. Recruiting ops will triage urgent cases.
Sam Gomez: Will update the doc and include a short troubleshooting checklist: 1) check LMS audit for event, 2) run backfill, 3) escalate to infra if POSTs return 5xx.
Samir Khan: Canary healthy. Ravi, ready for the CSV.
Ravi Shah: Export posted: https://files.redwood/lms_exports/cal_v2_72h.csv (14 rows). Running backfill now and will paste counts when done.
Samir Khan: Backfill completed: 14 profiles updated, 0 failures. Re-enabled panel creation for new interviewers. Closing loop, will follow up with a retro and a small test added to connector CI to assert both event names. :thumbsup:
